message.reasoning:
The user says "start Docker on window using docker start." They want to start Docker on Windows using docker start. But docker start is used to start containers, not the Docker service itself. To start Docker Desktop or Docker Engine on Windows, you might use services.msc or sc start com.docker.service. Or use Docker Desktop UI. But maybe they want to start a container named "window"? Not sure. The phrase "start Docker on window" could mean "start Docker on Windows". So we need to execute a command to start Docker service. On Windows, Docker Desktop runs as a service named "com.docker.service". So we can run `sc start com.docker.service`. Alternatively, if using Docker Desktop, you can start it via `Start-Process -FilePath "C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe"`.

But the tool expects a Windows command line instruction. We can use `sc start com.docker.service`. Let's do that. We'll call the function with command "sc start com.docker.service".
